plugins.name: expo-marketing-stack
plugins.description: Install and wire an opinionated Expo analytics/marketing stack (Superwall, RevenueCat, Amplitude, Adjust, Facebook, TikTok) into an Expo app, with a shared tracking plan and root-layout wiring. Bundles a working reference implementation; no API keys needed at install time.
